status: partially calibrated scenario; not validated as representative of a future all-service Solid population

included: structured communication records and synthetic text excerpts
excluded: original image, video, and attachment binary payloads
not_calibrated_or_complete: joint population distribution of complete service exports

communication.limitation: Export availability establishes a record family, not counts, retention, text sizes or message arrival rates.

transactions.evidence_class: observational mean anchor with explicit capture and retention assumptions
transactions.source_population: United States consumers in the Diary of Consumer Payment Choice
transactions.derivation: 47 minus 6 = approximately 41 noncash payments/month; source components are rounded
transactions.capture_assumption: One queryable retained record per noncash payment; not all bank transactions are payments and not all payment-service representations are one-to-one.
transactions.limitation: The observed approximate mean anchors the generated transaction average after mixture normalization. It does not validate a five-year retained distribution, the synthetic mixture tails, other countries, synthetic amounts/currencies, or account-transfer duplication.
transactions.rounding_rule: round(41 / 1.21) gives integer unit-intensity rate34; the assumed mixture yields expected41.14records/month before finite-sample variation.

activity.limitation: Does not model complete medical history or fine-grained wearable streams.

location.limitation: Geolife motivates episodic trajectory data but its historical selected cohort does not validate this monthly count, and actual trajectories are not replayed.

media.limitation: Metadata only. Source export formats do not establish population counts or retention.

ratings.sampling: Deterministic inverse empirical CDF; synthetic record values and dates are not source observations.
ratings.limitation: Historical selected users who joined in 2000, supplied demographics and rated at least 20 movies. The observed retained count is independent of the modeled retention horizon and provides no annual arrival-rate estimate.

population_intensity.limitation: Shared intensity imposes positive cross-service volume correlation; neither mixture prevalence nor correlation strength has been measured. Its expected multiplier is1.21; transaction unit-intensity rate is normalized to approximate the observational mean. The source does not validate this synthetic tail.

resource_packaging.rule: One named graph per service/month, with contacts stored in one snapshot graph. Records spread evenly across months and deterministically across 28 day positions; burst and seasonal retention patterns are not reproduced.

access_control.evidence_class: scenario assumptions motivated by application roles; frequencies not measured
access_control.owner: Named owner has read/write/append/control on content
access_control.group: Four named recipients read media metadata
access_control.direct_exceptions: Every tenth calendar/media monthly document is owner-only
access_control.wac_encoding: Nearest governing ACL; agentGroup for shared media; own ACL shadows inherited grants on private exceptions
access_control.acp_encoding: Cumulative memberAccessControl; named group membership expansion; deny inherited recipients on private exceptions
access_control.correctness: Independent intended-rights oracle and independently parsed policy-language references; server must additionally compare actual enforcement and query results before timing.

literal_compressibility.compact_limitation: Repeated message excerpts and regular labels make compressed storage more favorable than unknown complete personal exports. Compact numeric values repeat across corresponding Pod record positions.
literal_compressibility.evidence_class: declared compressibility and text-length sensitivity; not observed population text statistics
unchanged: categorical currencies, units and media types
literal_compressibility.alphabet: 64 safe ASCII characters, six pseudo-random bits per character; deterministic Pod-specific seed
literal_compressibility.interpretation: Compare actual independently compressed per-Pod frames. Neither the regular compact strings nor high-entropy synthetic strings establish the compressibility of complete future service exports.
literal_compressibility.regular_limitation: Repeated excerpts and regular labels remain favorable to compression even though numeric values now vary independently per Pod. Version1 is preserved by deserializing its config with the omitted literal_profile defaulting to compact.
